note: Extract of the French durability index (indice de durabilité). National French score, not an EU score.
title: TVs ranked by the French durability index
scale: 0 to 10 (indice de durabilité, Code de l'environnement, Art. L. 541-9-2); sub-scores repairability and reliability 0 to 10
method: Sorted by the score as published by the company that placed the model on the French market, rounded to one decimal. No own rating. Ranks are consecutive (1, 2, 3); with equal scores, the longer spare parts supply (upper bound of years) comes first, then the name. One row per model (entries with the same model name or barcode merged, newest entry kept).
